items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: The first first funeral I played right after I got out the name I forgot about was with Peter Bocah and Paul Bob Randall Snare.

ctx.x: You ever played bass drum in the parade?

Yeah. I played lots of bass drums in the funerals. Oh yeah I'm glad you mentioned that. The first first funeral I played right after I got out the name I forgot about was with Peter Bocah and Paul Bob Randall Snare.
